plan.archetype: Flexible poison scaling with efficient damage and defense
plan.bossPrep: Acquire reliable poison, upgraded weakness and defensive scaling. Establish powers during sleep; preserve enough HP to survive attacks and stat drains.
plan.summary: Improve immediate damage first, then build poison and efficient defense. Remove Strikes after replacing their damage. Take elites selectively with potions and strong cards; heal when survival requires it.

plan.archetype: Attack burst transitioning into poison scaling and efficient defense
plan.bossPrep: Acquire reliable poison to withstand stat drains, improve sustained defense, and save useful potions. Upgrade Skewer or Neutralize when health permits.
plan.summary: Heal now for the forced elite. Prioritize poison and defensive scaling over additional unscaled attacks. Remove Strikes, avoid optional elites, and upgrade Skewer or Neutralize when safe.

plan.archetype: Opening burst supporting accelerated poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish poison acceleration and dexterity defense, improve AoE, upgrade core powers and Neutralize, and reserve defensive potions for growing multihit attacks.
plan.summary: Use Cocoa for reliable opening setup and burst. Shop early for scaling, AoE, and potions; remove Strikes. Fight two rested elites. Heal when necessary; otherwise upgrade core defense and poison.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling protected by sustained Weak and efficient defense
plan.bossPrep: Heal at both remaining campfires. Establish After Image, maintain Weak, build poison, and save defensive potions for multihits.
plan.summary: Keep the immediate campfire route; the alternative exhausts HP. Heal twice and avoid optional elites. Prioritize defensive scaling and poison acceleration over more unscaled attacks.

plan.archetype: Free opening After Image supporting accelerated poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Strip Artifact with Expose; establish accelerated poison and dexterity. Keep discard for Wither, defensive potions, and sufficient HP for consecutive bosses.
plan.summary: Free opening After Image stabilizes setup. Use two shops and three campfires for poison acceleration, dexterity, upgrades, and potions. Remove weak cards, preserve replay Defend, and avoid extra elites.

plan.bossPrep: Strip Artifact with Expose, establish Accelerant and poison promptly, preserve discard for Wither, and secure defensive potions and HP for both bosses.
plan.summary: Heal now and avoid further elites. Shop for defensive scaling, poison support, and boss potions before optional removal. Preserve replay Defend. Heal at the final campfire unless safely near full; otherwise upgrade Shadowmeld or Bouncing Flask.

plan.archetype: Efficient early damage into poison and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade reliable poison and defensive scaling; maintain Weak, save a useful potion, and bring sufficient damage to cross the Beast’s stun threshold promptly.
plan.summary: Prioritize efficient damage and an AoE solution early. Add poison sources before Accelerant, then dexterity and strong block. Remove Strikes; take elites selectively with healthy HP and potions.

plan.archetype: Rolling Boulder scaling with Weak and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Recover HP, maintain Weak, and establish Boulder safely. Seek dexterity and an emergency potion; upgrade Boulder when healing is unnecessary.
plan.summary: Avoid elites and heal at both remaining fires. Support Boulder with efficient defense, dexterity, and energy. Add reliable damage without bloating the deck or taking unsupported poison payoffs.
